search_text: published ZDI-19-223 ZDI-CAN-7162 Malwarebytes Anti-Malware URI Handler Remote Command Execution Vulnerability 2019-02-20 CVE-2019-6739 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2019-6739 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Malwarebytes'] ['Anti-Malware'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Malwarebytes Anti-Malware. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious web page. There is an issue with the way the product handles URIs within certain schemes. The product does not warn the user that a dangerous navigation is about to take place. Because special characters in the URI are not sanitized, this could lead to the execution of arbitrary commands. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user at medium integrity. This vulnerability report was resolved by builds including and after 3.6.1.2711-1.0.508. title: Malwarebytes Anti-Malware URI Handler Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Malwarebytes Anti-Malware. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious web page. There is an issue with the way the product handles URIs within certain schemes. The product does not warn the user that a dangerous navigation is about to take place. Because special characters in the URI are not sanitized, this could lead to the execution of arbitrary commands. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user at medium integrity.
